description: This PHP class file defines the PayGradeModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's API layer. It models the 'Pay Grade' entity for administrative purposes, providing data serialization into an array format, including related currency information.

classes.name: PayGradeModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing PayGrade entities along with their associated currencies for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PayGrade entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the PayGrade entity and its currencies into an associative array suitable for API output.
